title: Knot Detail Jacquard Shawl Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads in this stunning evening dress! Featuring elegant jacquard fabric, chic knot detailing, and dramatic cape sleeves, this gown exudes timeless sophistication. Perfect for formal events, it offers a flattering silhouette that ensures you'll shine all night long!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Cape sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises jacquard.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
